recipes.name: Homemade Hazelnut Butter
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*. Spread the hazelnuts onto a baking tray and bake for 9 to 10 minutes, until lightly golden, stirring once halfway.
Place the toasted hazelnuts in a food processor (ideally 900W or higher). Blend on high for about 6 to 8 minutes, or until smooth**.

page_recipe_notes: Notes † If your hazelnuts have the brown skin still on, you'll have to remove it after you take them out of the oven. When cooled enough to handle, rub them firmly between the palms of your hands. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). Be careful not to overcook, as the nuts continue to 'cook' even when taken out of the oven. ** If your food processor isn't very powerful, blend for an additional 5 minutes to achieve the desired consistency. You can also add a bit of neutral-tasting oil to help the process along. Using a blender is not advised.
Storage Store in an airtight container or mason jar in a cool, dry, and dark place for up to 1 month. Store in the fridge for up to 3 months.
